question: The Indian Independence Act of 1947 resulted in the partition of India into how many dominions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Indian Independence Act of 1947** was passed by the British Parliament to facilitate the partition of British India into **two dominions**, namely India and Pakistan.
 
• The Act received royal assent on **July 18, 1947**, and the partition was implemented on **August 15, 1947**.
